text:
alex: FYI got a burn-rate alert for SLO api-latency-99 for tenant=acme-corp. Can someone point me to traces + raw logs so I can start triage? Need to decide if we should tune the alert or escalate.

sre-bot: ALERT: SLO burn rate > 1.2 for api-latency-99 (5m window) — alert_ts: 2026-11-02T15:04:59Z — link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/12345 :rotating_light:

maria: Start with the Grafana SLO dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/slo/overview?var-slo=api-latency-99&var-tenant=acme-corp — that has p50/p95/p99 and burn-rate panels.

jason: For traces use Tempo/Jaeger: https://tempo.redwood.ai/search?query=tenant%3Aacme-corp%20service%3Ainference-api — set time to the alert window and filter by span.duration > 200ms.

maria: Kibana quick-filter for raw requests: https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/discover#/ (use this KQL)

```
tenant: "acme-corp" and service:"inference-api" and http.status_code >= 500
```

mike: If you want a single trace id from logs run this as a short Logs query and copy trace.id: 

```
processor.event: "request" and tenant:"acme-corp" and http.response_time > 200
| top 1 by @timestamp
| fields trace.id
```

alex: thanks — this fired twice in the last hour but both were ~5–7min spikes and then recovered. Any suggestions for quick tuning to reduce noise?

maria: A few options:
- increase burn window (e.g., 5m -> 15m) if these are micro-spikes and you only care about sustained regressions
- add per-tenant suppression rules for expected noisy tenants
- change numerator to exclude retried requests if retries are inflating the metric

First step is to confirm distribution (p95 vs p99) on the Grafana panel. If p99 only spikes and p95 stable, probably transient.

jason: also check node-level GPU queueing on Dedicated pool for that time range: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/node/dedicated-pool?from=now-1h&to=now — queuing can cause short tail latency.

alex: I'll pull a couple traces and paste ids here. assigning @maria to help with tuning if it's noisy :thumbsup:

maria: ack — paste the trace ids and I’ll stitch logs + spans. Runbook for SLO alerts is here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sre/slo-alert-playbook (steps for triage + when to escalate).

sre-bot: Note: created INC-2026 and added to on-call queue (priority: P3).

alex: thanks all — will update thread after I attach traces and a short summary.
